title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Standards for Jurisdiction of Basic People's Courts over First-Instance Intellectual Property Civil Cases
keywords_en: jurisdiction; intellectual property; jurisdiction over first-instance intellectual property civil cases
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the Standards for Basic People's Courts to Have Jurisdiction over First-instance Intellectual Property Civil Cases

Fa Fa [2010] No. 6

To the higher people's courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government, the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army, and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

Upon the requests of the relevant higher people's courts, the Standards for Basic People's Courts Currently Having Jurisdiction over General Intellectual Property Civil Cases to Have Jurisdiction over First-instance Intellectual Property Civil Cases (see attachment), as approved by the Supreme People's Court, are hereby uniformly issued and shall come into effect as of February 1, 2010. Cases already accepted before that date shall still be subject to the original standards of each locality.

This notice is hereby given.

Attachment: Standards for Basic People's Courts to Have Jurisdiction over First-instance Intellectual Property Civil Cases

January 28, 2010

Attachment:

Standards for Basic People's Courts to Have Jurisdiction over First-instance Intellectual Property Civil Cases

Correction: "Xuanwu District People's Court" after Nanjing City, Jiangsu Province should be "Xuanwu District People's Court" (玄武区人民法院); "Nansin District People's Court" after Chengdu City, Sichuan Province should be "High-tech District People's Court" (高新区人民法院).
